line_items.reasoning: FY26 adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $19.30–$20.10 (midpoint ~$19.70), well above the prior midpoint of $18.40, indicating Q3 results came in materially ahead of the implied quarterly trajectory guided last quarter.
Consolidated Q3 revenue grew 8% YoY and FEC revenue grew 10% YoY, both exceeding the prior guidance of 5–6% consolidated FY26 growth and ~7% FEC YoY growth implied at midpoint.

FEC delivered its sixth consecutive quarter of margin expansion (+50 bps) with adjusted operating income up 18%, exceeding the guidance of only 'up slightly' at midpoint; however, FedEx Freight AOI headwind worsened to $400M vs. the guided $300M, making this a partial beat overall but FEC clearly outperformed.

FedEx Freight's full-year AOI headwind was revised to $400M from the prior guidance of $300M, with revenue down 5% YoY — worse than the 'approximately flat to slightly down' revenue expectation and a meaningful miss on the profit headwind estimate.
FY26 CapEx was reduced to no more than $4.1B (potentially as low as $3.8B implied), beating the prior $4.5B target by at least $400M.
